answers.reason: The senate decides on overall university matters and is chaired by the president, so the student representative does not take part there.
The budget planning round allocates funds centrally, which is outside the faculty-specific scope of the student representative.
Appointment committees select candidates for professorships, not a matter for student representatives.
The faculty council decides on faculty affairs where students have an elected representative.
The study commission advises on teaching and degree programmes in the faculty, which concerns students.
The examination board decides on individual examination matters, not a general body for student representatives.
Internal research funding is for research projects, not part of the student representative's assigned matters.
Module revisions relate to degree programmes dealt with in study commissions or faculty councils.
Laboratory equipment procurement is a specialized administrative or technical task.
Orientation week planning concerns students, but is not listed as the specific body where the representative's matters are decided.
